**Solo autorización: este reporte no sum:
**Authorization only: this report does not add mission credit.**
Wait for the leader to open the session and staff to approve your report before playing. Every shinobi, including squad members, needs individual authorization.

Attach **one uncropped full-screen screenshot** showing Open World, TAB with villages visible, the M menu with your level and stats, your username and the device date/time. Keep all four stat values legible; move the user panel if it covers them.
State your village, whom you will play with (ally/enemy and usernames), and the requested activity or encounter. Enter allocated CHI, NIN, TAI and HP points, not maximum bar values or unspent points.

Staff compare your information with the screenshot and decide whether to authorize. There is no automatic image recognition. PNG/JPG/WEBP, up to 8 MiB. Images go to the configured review channel; do not expose the private code or personal information.
**Un reporte = una misión completada.**: **One report = one completed mission.** Include each participant once. Upload 1–4 full screenshots with device date/time, identity and a legible objective panel. **Execution: at least 2 screenshots**, during execution and showing the target K/O or dead as required. **Capture: show the captured target**, plus delivery if required. Cargo, scroll or protection: show the result and panel progress; add completion evidence if needed. Screenshots do not have to be taken 1–2 seconds before the end. Staff verify the result, not only the timer. Create blue quests outside Open World with /reports blue_quest; they are rank D. Other reports require session authorization for every participant. All entered times use Colombia time (UTC−5). PNG/JPG/WEBP, up to 8 MiB each. Review is manual.

panel.registration.title: 📜 World X · Shinobi registration
panel.registration.body:
Press the button to create or resume your character. Complete your details, assignment, name, specialty and three screenshots: character/level, Roblox username and stats/age/slots menu. Staff review your character. Age and gender refer to the character. One active character per account.

🌐 /language selects Spanish, English or automatic. /help shows your commands.
panel.assignment.title: 🌀 World X · Shinobi birth
panel.assignment.body:
Create **/my_character** → **/assignment start** → village → choose the order of Elements, Primary and Secondary.

Three TOTAL spins per section. Each spin replaces the previous result. Confirm even after the third spin. Reserved requirements are preserved.

Older births keep their rules. New births allow 0–4 element slots and up to four bloodlines. No elements: Kenichi; Mecha is an exception with Menza.

Finish your birth, choose a name, complete your character sheet and submit it to staff.
panel.economy.title: 💰 World X · Shinobi treasury
panel.economy.body:
Shop • Inventory • Wallet • Market
Monthly salary is split into two installments, subject to activity. Approved missions are paid separately from the village treasury. Purchases are RP permissions, not Roblox unlocks. See /help and /teaching.
panel.authorization.title: 🛡️ Open World authorization
panel.authorization.body: Every shinobi needs individual authorization before playing, including squad members. Press the button and read the full-screen screenshot instructions for TAB, the M menu, stats, username and date/time. Wait for approval. This report adds no mission credit. Do not post the private code.
panel.mission.title: 📜 Completed mission report
panel.mission.body: One report per mission, with each participant included once. Attach 1–4 screenshots showing the objective panel, result and date/time. Execution needs two screenshots; capture missions must show the captured target. A timer alone is insufficient. Staff review the report and the Kage authorizes payment. Rank D blue quests outside Open World: /reports blue_quest.

v8.incompatible: No valid combination exists under these rules or caps. Your spin was not spent; ask staff to review the balance.
v8.unique_taken: That exclusive slot is already reserved. Your spin was not spent.
v8.choose_order: Choose the order of your three sections
v8.order_locked: The order is already locked or this birth is frozen.
v8.roll_rules: Three TOTAL spins per section. Each spin replaces the previous result; confirming locks that section and preserves other sections’ spins. Obligations from earlier results are always respected.
v8.all_elements: Access to all five basic natures. Only four equipped at once; technique permits are still required.
v8.quota_notice: Your allocation is {lineage}. This primary is retained across all three spins. There is one per block of 100 births started, not per 100 approvals.
v8.order_intro: 📜 Choose what to spin first. The order is locked without spending spins. A bloodline obtained first reserves its required elements; elements confirmed first constrain later combinations.
v8.order_saved: Order saved. You can now spin.
v8.finished_odds: Your birth is complete. Use /assignment status.
v8.element_odds: Initial 0–4 slot distribution. It is conditioned on reserved requirements, not a promise of final population.
v8.odds_note: Optional candidate chances per attempt. Obligations and allocations shown in the panel take priority. Remaining mass is an empty result. These are not final population percentages.
v8.balance_help: Owner only. Selecting a probability mode saves it immediately for new births. Existing births retain their mode. Lifetime unique limits apply to all modes. Other edits use review and confirmation.
v8.balance_overview: Hardcore: v8 weights. Normal: equal weights among eligible candidates per draw. Easy: 80% main, 15% secondary only, 5% Lee; main → secondary → elements order preserves the group. Three spins per section.
v8.invalid_json: Invalid JSON or missing required fields.
v8.claims_note: Historical slots and pending reservations. history: means one lifetime holder per bloodline. Completed births never release their slot on reset. Slots are not renewed every 100 births.
v8.mecha_notice: No elements. Menza is its mandatory exception; other secondary bloodlines remain unavailable.
v8.secondary_access_note: May switch ordinary no-mode secondary bloodlines, with at most four bloodlines equipped. Excludes exclusives and jinchūriki bloodlines. Permits are still required.
v8.equip_locked: Finish your birth and use an editable or approved character sheet. You cannot change it during a review.
v8.equip_empty: Enter elements or secondary bloodlines separated by commas. Use none to clear secondary slots.
v8.equip_elements: Only births with access to five natures may switch between earth, water, fire, wind and lightning. Maximum four slots.
v8.equip_secondary: Your access does not permit this combination. Only Narumaki, Yang-Narumaki and Tetsuo-Kaijin may switch ordinary no-mode secondaries, excluding exclusives, jinchūriki reservations and incompatible families. Maximum four total bloodlines.
v8.equip_saved: Slots saved. This does not purchase permits or restore spins.
